title: Heavy Repairs and the Ridgeline Tool Rental Missing-Accessory Charge
content:
When a Ridgeline Tool Rental unit comes back needing a heavy repair, the repair takes in the accessories and the missing-accessory charge is lowered.

A heavy repair takes in the accessories: when the repair cost assessed at the same inspection is 10000.00 dollars or more, the charge is multiplied by 0.50; when it is 2500.00 dollars or more but below 10000.00 dollars, by 0.75; when it is below 2500.00 dollars, it is unchanged.

The repair cost is the one recorded on the return inspection line that counted the missing accessories.

The multiplier acts on the accessories charged multiplied by the class charge per accessory not returned, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

## Repair bands

| Repair cost assessed at the inspection | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 10000.00 or more | 0.50 |
| 2500.00 up to 9999.99 | 0.75 |
| below 2500.00, including no damage | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical figures (one accessory at 60.00 before the multiplier)

| Repair cost | Figure |
|---|---|
| 10000.00 | 30.00 |
| 2500.00 | 45.00 |
| 2499.99 | 60.00 |
